title: SWF compile: PlaceObject2 Move flag missing on CXForm updates and text+CXForm drops instanceName
description:
Two related SWF encoder bugs in packages/swf/src/compile.ts:

BUG 1 — PlaceObject2 Move flag missing on CXForm/color-effect updates:
When a SymbolInstance with a colorEffect changes between frames (posChanged=true, isFirst=false), the encode path uses encodePlaceObject2WithCXForm without the Move flag. This replaces the character at that depth instead of modifying it in place — wrong behavior, Ruffle will flash or duplicate the object. The fix: when posChanged=false (or the character is already placed) and only the color effect changes, use a variant that sets HasMove flag. Study how encodePlaceObject2Move works and add a similar CXForm-with-Move variant or add Move flag to the existing CXForm encoder. Look at compile.ts lines ~1840-1900.

BUG 2 — Named text field with colorEffect loses instanceName:
When a text field has BOTH a non-null colorEffect AND an instanceName, the code selects the CXForm path (encodePlaceObject2WithCXForm) which has no name parameter. The result: the text field loses its AS2-addressable instance name. Fix: add a new encoder variant encodePlaceObject2WithCXFormAndName, or use PlaceObject3 (tag 70) with HasColorTransform + HasName flags. Look at compile.ts lines ~1783-1805 and the encoder helpers in packages/swf/src/shapes.ts. PlaceObject3 already handles filters; check if it can also handle name + CXForm.

After fixing, run: pnpm --filter @flash/swf run test -- --run AND pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui run test -- --run
Tests must stay at their current counts (no regressions).
Commit: fix(swf): PlaceObject2 Move flag on CXForm updates; text+CXForm preserves instanceName
